notablePrerequisites:
Najeela is your commander and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Najeela.
description:
Declare Najeela as an attacker, triggering itself and Ironsoul Enforcer.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ironsoul Enforcer trigger, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
